trap.label: told … to
trap.wrong: He advised that I rest and I should have take a break.
trap.right: He advised me to rest, and I should have taken a break.
trap.why: Em português “aconselhou que eu descansasse” usa que + subjuntivo, e “deveria ter tomado” soa similar com ter. Em inglês: advise + pessoa + to; should have + particípio.

fix.wrong: We had left when he calls.
fix.right: We had left when he called.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “Be careful,” he said to me.
rewrite.answer: He told me to be careful.
